description: Prepares a callback request to the provider's team and shows it to the user as a card with the details and a send button. Use it only when the user explicitly asks to be called back or to speak to a person, and has told you in this chat their first name and ONE way to reach them (a phone number or an email address); ask for these first, and for a preferred time if they have one. Pass cruise_ids (from find_cruises, up to 5) only if the request is about those offers. It does NOT send anything: the user checks the details and presses the button on the card. It does not book, hold or price a cruise, and the draft is deleted after 30 minutes.

cruise_ids.description: cruise_id values from find_cruises the request is about. Optional.

email.description: Email address. Pass it only if the user prefers email to a call.

first_name.description: The user's first name, as they gave it. Letters only.

handle.description: Consultation handle returned by a previous call (structuredContent.handle). Pass it on every call so wishes are remembered; omit it on the very first call.

language.description: Language of the answer. Defaults to the provider's language.

phone.description: Phone number with area code. Pass phone OR email, one of them.

preferred_time.description: When the user would like to be reached, in their own words, e.g. 'weekdays after 5 pm'. Optional.

name: prepare_callback
title: Prepare a callback request
